items.title: EchoFG: display timing (the generated frame's present blocks 17-20 ms): vsync / VRR / frame latency
items.blocked_on: owner (retest EchoFG now that GPU scaling is on; the Saints Row 2 profile's Sync mode and Max frame latency)
items.note: 2026-10-11: display 4K 120 Hz, G-Sync on in fullscreen and windowed, GPU scaling just switched on (it fixed a TV problem; the glitchy test was before it). WoW profile: Sync mode Default, Max frame latency 1, HDR and G-Sync support on, capture DXGI, NIS. Offline study (nr_fgpresent sync= tearing= latency= buffers= size=4): at 4K, a 30 fps source x2, NO combination makes the generated frame's Present wait (0.05 ms every time); only a 60 fps x2 source (= the display's 120 Hz) fills the queue (~10 ms). The owner's 17-20 ms was not reproduced; the display line the 10-second log now carries (refreshes between presents) from the retest decides it.

items.title: EchoFG first-frame 50 ms hitch; further pass merging for cost (4K about 5 ms)
items.note: At 4K the first engine frame costs 0.3-0.4 s on the presenting thread once (1080p: ~90 ms): the first use of the shared frames by the second API (D3D11 Signal / D3D12 hand-over, whichever goes second); touching them on the start-up thread only moved the cost. The slow-frame log line now splits it.
